Categories Australia Australian Banks Australian Budget Australian Dollar Australian Economy Australian Interest Rates Australian Politics Australian Property Australian Shares Immigration International Students Superannuation Commodities Australian LNG Gold Iron Ore Price Global Macro Capitalism Carbon Economy China Economy Economics European Economy New Zealand Economy US Economy Company About Comment Policy Contact Disclaimer Australian Shares Is the AI crash over? David Llewellyn-Smith Monday 26 October 2026 Add MacroBusiness as a preferred source Advertisement TME asks the question. DB nailed the tech unwind. Now what? Credit where it’s due. On October 9, Deutsche Bank’s Binky Chadha and team tactically downgraded tech from overweight to neutral, warning of an unfavorable risk/reward setup and a potential sharp reversal.
